The topics and dates of future lectures may change.

Winter quarter runs from Tuesday, January 5 to Friday, March 19, 2027,
and the last week, March 15 to 19, is finals week.
Lectures meet on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
Each section's two-hour lab meets once a week, on Thursday or Friday;
the [syllabus](syllabus.qmd#sections) lists the times and rooms.
There is no class on Monday, January 18 (Martin Luther King Jr. Day)
or Monday, February 15 (Presidents' Day),
the third Mondays of January and February,
which are holidays for Washington's state colleges and universities
([WAC 357-31-005](https://app.leg.wa.gov/Wac/default.aspx?cite=357-31-005)).

Canvas lists every due date and is the place to submit work.

- Homework is due on Friday at 10pm,
  with no penalty until 10pm that Sunday.
  Homework 6 has no extension.
- Each lab is due at 10pm on the Monday after the lab,
  or on the next class day when that Monday is a holiday.
- Quiz 0 is given in week 1.

Midterms 1 and 2 are in class on Wednesday, January 27 and Wednesday, February 17.
The final exam is 10:30am to 12:30pm in finals week,
on a day set by the lecture time of your section:
WWU's [finals schedule](https://registrar.wwu.edu/calendars/finals)
puts classes that start between 10:30 and 11:29am and meet on neither Tuesday nor Thursday on Tuesday, March 16,
and those that start between 8:30 and 9:29am on Thursday, March 18.
A class's lab does not change its exam slot.
